article.story: HUNTINGTON, W.Va. -- — Wyatt Fricks scored 28 points as Marshall beat Old Dominion 97-88 on Tuesday night. Landen Joseph and Noah Otshudi each added 18 points for the Thundering Herd (19-11, 11-6 Sun Belt Conference). Ketron Shaw led the way for the Monarchs (10-20, 6-11) with 26 points and seven rebounds. Old Dominion also got 24 points, four assists and two steals from Jordan Battle. Caelum Swanton-Rodger also had 17 points and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
